title: MortarBench: Evaluating Mortgage Loan Origination Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.19416v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Loan origination is the process by which a lender creates a new loan, from application and underwriting through approval and funding. This process serves a critical role in evaluating the eligibility and level of risk posed by an applicant. Recently, firms have begun using mortgage loan agents to augment human loan officers, despite a lack of any public benchmark. To fill this gap, we present MortarBench, a loan origination agent benchmark. MortarBench uses a financial data synthesis and mutation pipeline to generate examples with broad edge case coverage that match real-world distributions and questions. We find that state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) perform poorly, with closed-source models achieving at most 77.1\% exact match accuracy. translated_title: MortarBench：评估抵押贷款发起智能体
translated_abstract: 摘要：贷款发起是贷方创建新贷款的过程，从申请和承保到批准和资金发放。这一过程在评估申请人资格和风险水平方面起着关键作用。近期，尽管缺乏任何公开基准，企业已开始使用抵押贷款智能体来辅助人类贷款专员。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MortarBench，一个贷款发起智能体基准。MortarBench使用财务数据合成和变异流水线生成具有广泛边缘案例覆盖的示例，这些示例匹配真实世界分布和问题。我们发现最先进的大型语言模型（LLM）表现不佳，闭源模型的最精确匹配准确率仅为77.1%。我们还发现LLM对非英语姓名相关的外国性感知存在系统性偏见。注意到这些弱点，我们引入了CRIT，一个置信度校准框架。我们的方法……
tldr: 本文提出了首个抵押贷款发起智能体基准MortarBench，揭示了当前LLM在此任务上的低性能及对外国姓名的系统性偏见，并引入CRIT置信度校准框架来缓解这些问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MortarBench, the first benchmark for mortgage loan origination agents, revealing poor LLM performance and systematic foreignness biases, and proposes CRIT, a confidence calibration framework to address them.
